question: A café starts the morning with 47 pastries baked. By mid-morning, 25 more pastries come out of the oven. Then 32 pastries are sold to the first wave of customers. By afternoon, 73 more pastries are baked for a catering order. By evening, 106 pastries are delivered to that catering event, a delivery that takes 40 minutes, well under an hour. How many pastries does the café have left?

In the morning, Priya has 201 dollars in a shared trip fund with her friend Wes, whose personal savings hold 500 dollars separately. By midday, she adds 17 more dollars from a refund. In the afternoon, she adds 69 more dollars from selling old textbooks. By evening, she spends 139 dollars on a plane ticket deposit. She then splits what's left evenly among 4 friends for a group gift, keeping only her own share. How many dollars is Priya's share?

A community orchestra starts the season with 137 sheet music copies in its library, in a hall that also stores 300 unrelated folding chairs. A donor gift adds 57 more copies. A publisher deal multiplies the collection by 6. The librarian then splits the collection evenly among 4 storage cabinets, and only one cabinet's copies are tracked from here. That cabinet gains 34 more copies from a late order. A doubling grant then doubles that cabinet's copies. Finally, 475 copies are sent out on loan to a partner orchestra. How many sheet music copies does that cabinet have now?

Owen has 116 dollars in his esports winnings account, far less than his rival streamer Kai's 900 dollars. A tournament payout multiplies Owen's winnings by 9. He then earns 13 more dollars from a small bracket. He earns another 45 dollars from a sponsor bonus. A subscriber donation adds 55 more dollars. A tip jar adds 11 more dollars. Finally, he pays 874 dollars in taxes and fees. How many dollars does Owen have left in his account?

Priya has 61 dollars in her wallet, more than her brother Sam's 20 dollars. She spends 19 dollars on lunch. She then spends 32 dollars on a movie ticket and popcorn. Her grandmother gives her 42 dollars, joking that it's really 4200 cents. Finally, she finds 17 more dollars in an old coat pocket. How many dollars does Priya have now?

In the morning, Grace has 25 dollars in her lunch money, less than her classmate Priya's 80 dollars. By midmorning, she spends 19 dollars on a school field trip fee. Later that morning, she spends 5 dollars on a snack. In the afternoon, a reward from a class contest multiplies her remaining money by 4. She then spends 2 dollars on a pencil. By evening, a bonus from selling raffle tickets multiplies her money by 4 again. Finally, her dad gives her 58 more dollars. How many dollars does Grace have now?

In the morning, a car dealership has 177 vehicles on the lot, more than a rival dealership across town that has 90 vehicles. By midday, 67 more vehicles arrive by truck. In the afternoon, a regional distribution deal multiplies the lot's inventory by 8. By late afternoon, 34 more vehicles arrive from an auction. By evening, 1539 vehicles are transferred to other branch lots, a transfer logged as taking 300 minutes, or five hours. Finally, 12 more vehicles arrive from a trade-in event. How many vehicles are on the lot now?

In the morning, Carlos has 116 dollars in his food truck's cash register, more than his competitor Nina's register, which starts with 50 dollars. By midmorning, he pays 37 dollars for ice. He then pays 21 dollars for napkins and cups. In the afternoon, a lunch rush multiplies his register total by 6. By late afternoon, he pays 242 dollars to restock ingredients, a delivery that takes 60 minutes, or exactly one hour. By evening, he pays 34 more dollars for propane. Finally, he pays 45 dollars to a part-time helper. How many dollars does Carlos have in his register now?

A butterfly garden starts the season with 95 chrysalises in its enclosure, in a greenhouse that has operated for half a century, unrelated to today's count. A new batch adds 20 more chrysalises. Then 63 emerge as butterflies and are released, removed from the chrysalis count. A donation from a breeding program multiplies the remaining chrysalises by 9. Then 31 more chrysalises arrive from a school project. Finally, 55 more arrive from a nature center partnership. How many chrysalises does the enclosure have now?

A hardware co-op starts the day with 105 shovels in stock. Then 2 shovels are returned as defective. Another 80 shovels are sold to a landscaping crew. A supplier bonus then doubles the remaining stock. The co-op then splits that stock evenly between two branch stores, and only one branch's half is tracked. How many shovels does that branch have now?

A juice bar starts the morning with 21 gallons of orange juice, in a shop that also sells 12 unrelated smoothie cups. By midmorning, 10 gallons are used for the first rush of orders. A concentrate mix then multiplies the remaining juice by 7. A doubling of that batch happens when a second concentrate mix is added. Then 114 gallons are used to fulfill a catering order, a job that takes 90 minutes, or an hour and a half. Finally, 36 more gallons are used for the lunch rush. How many gallons of orange juice are left?

A shipping yard starts the day with 226 containers stacked. Then 30 containers are loaded onto an outbound ship. A rail delivery multiplies the remaining containers by 7. Afterward, 345 containers are moved to a customs holding area, a process that takes 120 minutes, or two hours. Finally, a second rail delivery multiplies the stack by 9. How many containers are in the yard now?

In the morning, a mining operation extracts 87 tons of ore. A rich vein multiplies the morning haul by 8. By midday, a second vein multiplies it by 5. In the afternoon, the ore is split evenly among 4 processing plants, and only one plant's share is tracked. That plant's share is multiplied by 5 during a refining boost. By evening, a second refining pass multiplies it by 7. Finally, 20759 tons are shipped out to fulfill an export order. How many tons of ore does that plant have left?

Ben has 14 seashells in his collection, fewer than his sister Amy's 50 seashells. A beachcombing trip triples his collection. Then 18 shells are given away to friends. He finds 22 more shells on a second trip. Then 10 shells are lost when a bag rips. Finally, 18 more shells are set aside for a school project and removed from his count. How many seashells does Ben have now?

A server hosting company starts the month with 55 gigabytes of data backed up. A client migration multiplies the backup by 9. A second migration multiplies it by 6. A third multiplies it by 5. A fourth multiplies it by 7, a transfer that takes 180 minutes, or three hours. Finally, 12 more gigabytes are added from a manual upload. How many gigabytes of data are backed up now?

In the morning, a call center handles 161 calls, in an office that also has 40 unused headsets in storage. A marketing campaign multiplies the call volume by 6. By midday, 51 more calls come in. In the afternoon, 45 more calls arrive. A product launch then triples the call volume. By evening, 1174 calls are resolved and closed out. Finally, a night shift surge multiplies the remaining open calls by 9. How many open calls remain at the end of the day?

In the morning, a grain silo holds 167 tons of wheat, on a farm that also has 30 unrelated cattle. A harvest delivery multiplies the silo's stock by 6. By midday, 42 more tons arrive from a second field. In the afternoon, 311 tons are shipped out to a mill. By evening, 224 more tons are shipped out to a second buyer. How many tons of wheat remain in the silo?

A crowdfunding campaign for Nadia's film starts with 200 dollars pledged, while a rival campaign run by Theo has already raised 900 dollars. The campaign page also lists 15 unrelated project tags, unused in any calculation. A first backer adds 51 more dollars. A second backer adds 36 dollars. A matching-grant announcement brings in 66 more dollars. A local news feature adds 20 more dollars. Finally, a last-minute surge adds 53 more dollars. How many dollars has Nadia's campaign raised now?

In the morning, Lena has 87 dollars in a joint vacation fund with her friend Priya, whose own personal savings hold 300 dollars separately. By midday, a matching bonus multiplies the fund by 6. In the afternoon, a second matching round multiplies it by 3. By late afternoon, 41 more dollars are added from a garage sale. By evening, 1312 dollars are spent booking flights, a purchase confirmed in just 5 minutes. Finally, the remaining fund is split evenly among 5 friends going on the trip, and Lena tracks only her own share. How many dollars is Lena's share?

In the morning, a school garden has 26 sunflowers blooming. A warm spell multiplies the bloom count by 7. By midday, 20 more sunflowers bloom. In the afternoon, 41 more bloom after a rain shower. By evening, a final growth spurt triples the whole count. How many sunflowers are blooming by the end of the day?

In the morning, a beekeeper collects 41 jars of honey. A strong harvest multiplies the morning collection by 7. By midday, a second harvest multiplies it by 4. In the afternoon, 571 jars are sold at a farmers market, a sale that runs 240 minutes, or four hours. By evening, 80 more jars come in from a final collection. How many jars of honey does the beekeeper have now?

A charity toy drive starts with 190 toys donated. Then 91 toys are distributed to a shelter early in the drive. A weekend donation adds 77 more toys. A matching-donor event then doubles the toy count. A school collection adds 69 more toys, delivered in a van ride that took 90 minutes, or an hour and a half. Finally, a citywide partnership multiplies the whole collection by 5. How many toys does the drive have now?

A construction crew starts the day with 70 steel beams delivered, on a site that also has 20 unrelated bags of cement. By midmorning, 11 more beams arrive. A supplier bonus then multiplies the beam count by 7. Then 305 beams are used to frame the first section of the building. Finally, a doubling of the remaining beams happens when a second identical shipment arrives. How many steel beams does the crew have now?

Jake has 26 dollars, more than his little brother Sam's 10 dollars. Jake splits his money evenly with a friend for a shared gift, keeping only half for himself. He then earns 7 more dollars doing chores. He spends 6 dollars on a snack. Finally, he spends 5 dollars on a bus fare. How many dollars does Jake have left?

In the morning, a bakery has 85 bagels ready. By midmorning, 79 more bagels come out of the oven. In the afternoon, 91 bagels are sold to a catering order. A wholesale distributor then multiplies the remaining bagels by 8. By evening, 48 more bagels are baked for the next day. Finally, 382 bagels are shipped out to fulfill a grocery store order. How many bagels does the bakery have left?
